A1.label: owner braindumps a feature in chat + triggers the skill

A2.label: agent researches the codebase (the skill's step 1)

A3.label: agent authors questions.json + a DRAFT graph.json

A4.label: agent starts the local server and hands over a URL

A6.label: owner answers one question at a time — chart B

A10.label: agent reads answers.json and revises graph.json

A11.label: did the answers open NEW questions?

A12.label: agent appends them to questions.json, status = awaiting_owner, mode = questions

A13.label: agent finalises the graph, writes assumptions / out-of-scope, status = awaiting_owner, mode = review

A14.label: owner reviews the graph on the canvas — chart F

A16.label: status = awaiting_agent, with the owner's annotations

A17.label: graph is frozen into versions/NNN/ and marked confirmed

A18.label: an implementation agent is handed the confirmed graph and writes the execution plan — chart G

B3.label: compute the REACHABLE set — chart C

B5.label: show the DONE screen — see Q28 for what it says

B6.label: pick the next question — see Q11 for the ordering rule

B7.label: render ONE question, self-contained: the text, every option PREFILLED and clickable with its CONSEQUENCE beside it, the recommended one marked, a free-text box, and a NOT RELEVANT button

B7a.label: is this a GATING question (its answer prunes others)?

B7b.label: each option also shows a → next preview: what kind of questions follow if you pick it

B18.label: NEW: exactly one control is MARKED as what Enter will press, and the mark is visible before the key is

B19.label: NEW: type in the note box and the mark MOVES to use what I wrote — Enter can never be the thing that discards what you typed

B20.label: NEW: every control shows the key that presses it

B11.label: record the recommended default, flagged unreviewed

B10.label: revisit an earlier question — chart D

B16.label: record as answered-with-override; the agent resolves it next round; keep going

B17.label: END THE ROUND NOW — chart B2

B12.label: server appends to answers.log, rewrites answers.json, fsyncs BOTH, and only then returns 200

B13.label: UI advances only after the 200 — nothing is ever shown as saved when it is not

B14.label: the changed answer may orphan later answers — chart D

P1.label: owner writes their own answer at a ⚑gate question

P2.label: the answer is saved like any other, marked needs_new_branch

P3.label: the UI stops asking — every remaining question sits on a branch the owner has just declined to take

P5.label: the agent picks it up immediately (chart E) — it does not wait for the rest of the questionnaire

P6.label: agent authors the new branch: a new option on that question, plus whatever questions it opens, plus gates on existing ones

P7.label: status = awaiting_owner; the owner resumes at the SAME question, now with their answer present as a real option

P8.label: answers already given on other branches are untouched

C1.label: for each question Q in questions.json

C3.label: not reachable-unanswered; its answer feeds other gates

C5.label: evaluate the gate against the current answers

C6.label: every identifier in the gate answered?

C7.label: PENDING — not askable yet, not pruned either

C10.label: PRUNED — never shown, and its own answer is discarded if it had one

C11.label: recompute after EVERY answer — one answer can prune dozens at once

D1.label: owner presses BACK, or clicks an earlier answer in the history list

D2.label: show that question with its recorded answer selected

D10.label: NEW: BACK is a VISIT STACK, like a browser's — the question this screen showed before this one, not the newest answer in the file

D11.label: NEW: the stack survives leaving for the canvas and coming back, so BACK is never the way out of the questionnaire

D12.label: NEW: with nothing above it — opened from the index or a canvas link — BACK means the question answered immediately before this one

D13.label: NEW: and at the first question there IS nothing before it, so BACK is disabled and says so, rather than doing nothing

D14.label: NEW: the history is a SIDEBAR, always on screen and scrollable, carrying the question AND the answer, not a screen you leave for

D6.label: do any LATER answers now sit on pruned questions?

D7.label: continue from the next reachable question

D8.label: those answers are marked inactive, not deleted

D9.label: the UI says plainly what just became irrelevant — see Q34

E1.label: owner answers the last reachable question

E3.label: how does the agent find out?

E4.label: the agent session runs a watch loop on status.json and wakes when owner_state flips

E5.label: the local server writes a sentinel file / exits with a code that the agent's blocking wait is already parked on

E6.label: owner says 'done' in chat; the agent reads the files

E8.label: agent revises graph.json, appends follow-ups or finalises

E9.label: agent writes status.json: agent_state = ready, mode = questions|review

E10.label: UI is polling status.json and switches itself over

E12.label: NEW: the watch writes a HEARTBEAT while it is parked

E14.label: the screen says an agent is watching, and since when

E15.label: the screen says the session STOPPED — nothing is lost, here is the prompt that starts another

E16.label: the screen says nobody is watching, and what that does and does not cost

E11.label: owner is notified — see Q49 for how

F2.label: canvas: the whole design graph, pan and zoom, beside a picker that shows one chart on its own

F12.label: NEW: cross-chart links — a node label that names another chart becomes a link to that chart, DERIVED from the label, never authored twice

F13.label: drawn distinctly: dashed, node to chart, so it can never be read as one of the edges the author actually drew

F14.label: the same links go into graph.json beside edges, so the canvas and an implementation agent are looking at one artefact — chart G

F3.label: side panel: assumptions, out-of-scope, open notes, the answers summary

F5.label: node detail: its text, which question decided it, and a free-text annotation box

F6.label: edge detail: the condition it represents, plus an annotation box

F7.label: saved immediately, same durability rule as answers

F8.label: a chart folds to one node so a 200-node graph stays legible, and its cross-chart links follow the fold

F9.label: jump to a node by ID or text

F11.label: freeze: snapshot into versions/NNN/, mark confirmed, emit the handoff artefact

G2.label: freeze graph.json + answers.json + annotations.json into versions/NNN/, never mutated again

G3.label: render a human-readable DESIGN.md beside it: the charts as mermaid, the decisions as prose, assumptions, out-of-scope

G4.label: an implementation agent is pointed at versions/NNN/

G5.label: it produces the EXECUTION PLAN — a separate document, as today

G6.label: the plan disagrees with the design?

G7.label: that is a design gap: back to Review again, not a silent decision

G8.label: implementation proceeds against a frozen, cited design

H2.label: one directory per design project, named by slug

H3.label: index page lists every project: name, status, last touched, confirmed version

H6.label: open read-only at its confirmed version

H8.label: a NEW version is started from the confirmed one; the old one stays frozen

J1.label: implementing agent is working a plan step (every step cites the design node IDs it implements)

J5.label: ASSUME: do it, append one line to ASSUMPTIONS.md citing the node. Never silently

J8.label: write gaps/GAP-NNN.md IN THE QUESTIONNAIRE GRAMMAR: what the design says, what it does not say, why it blocks, the options with consequences, blast radius, what was parked

J9.label: PARK that thread only — keep working every unaffected thread

J10.label: notify the owner: N gaps open, M threads parked, work continuing on the rest

J12.label: a SCOPED questionnaire: the gaps' own options as questions, plus whatever they open. Never the whole questionnaire again

J13.label: owner answers in chat; the agent records it against the gap

J14.label: gap stays open, thread stays parked, everything else proceeds

J15.label: design version N+1: changelog of nodes added/changed, questions added, gaps closed

J16.label: every plan step citing a CHANGED node is marked STALE

J17.label: stale steps are re-derived before they are worked again; untouched steps were never blocked and are not thrown away

I2.label: server not running when the owner opens the URL → a plain page saying how to start it, never a browser error

I3.label: port already taken → the tool picks the next free port and the URL it hands over reflects that

I4.label: two browser tabs open on the same project → both poll status.json; the second to act wins, and the other refreshes. No lock, because answers are idempotent per question ID

I5.label: owner edits answers.json by hand → it is plain JSON on purpose; the UI reloads it and carries on

I6.label: agent crashes mid-revision → graph.json is written atomically (temp + rename), so it is never half-written

I7.label: disk full / write fails → the POST returns non-200 and the UI does NOT advance; the owner sees the failure

I8.label: browser closed mid-round → nothing is lost; every answer was already on disk

edges.label: clicks an option AND writes a note
writes free text INSTEAD of choosing
two defensible choices differ in what the player sees / expensive to reverse / an owner call
